**THESIS STATUS: WEAKENED**

**ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE: 45%**

**OVERNIGHT SUMMARY:** Global risk-off sentiment with broad equity futures down ~0.2-0.3% and European markets mixed. VIX decline (-2.73%) provides some relief but composite scanner signal turned neutral (-0.0046) from yesterday's bullish read.

**KEY DEVELOPMENTS:**
• ES futures testing 6604 support, down -0.21% from yesterday's close
• Negative GEX regime confirmed (-836M) with put wall at 630 and call wall at 655
• Explosive volatility regime (30.9% confidence) suggests continued choppiness
• Polymarket macro sentiment bearish (-0.1542) with recession odds at 31.5%
• Asian markets divergent: Nikkei +1.26% vs Shanghai -1.00%

**TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS: ADJUST**

**TRADE NOTES:** Consider reducing position size by 50%. Current spot at 6604 puts us dangerously close to the put wall at 630 with limited upside to call wall at 655. The 656-657 call spread is now closer to ATM but facing headwinds from negative GEX and risk-off tone.

**DAY AHEAD RISKS:**
• Break below 6600 could trigger accelerated selling toward 630 put wall
• Explosive vol regime suggests potential for sharp intraday moves
• Negative GEX creating gamma headwinds for any rally attempts

**DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES:**
• VIX compression could support bounce if we hold 6600 support
• Call wall at 655 may provide resistance but also potential squeeze target
• Any Fed dovish commentary could reverse bearish macro sentiment
